newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: IMF team set to review Argentine fiscal accounts.
newsitem.headline: IMF team set to review Argentine fiscal accounts.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund team is set to arrive in Argentina Tuesday to review whether the country has met its fiscal targets in the first quarter, the Economy Ministry said.

Government officials and analysts say Argentina will meet the $1.04 billion deficit goal agreed with the IMF, paving the way for an expected three-year Extended Fund Facility loan to replace a stand-by accord ending this year.
IMF Managing Director Michel Camdessus is scheduled to visit Argentina in May.
Argentina's deficit target for 1997 is $3 billion, equivalent to about one percent of GDP, down from $6 billion last year.
The deficit forecast for this year rises to $4.5 billion when including the cost of transferring pensions from provinces to the cental government and of state layoffs.
